title: SpeeDao
tagline: SpeeDao is a Discord bot that focuses on transparency and accessibility to enhance participation
description:
We are building an ecosystem for improving the onboarding of communities to DAOS, the community interaction and the lack of high quality information. For the scope of this hackathon we are bulding a Discord bot

Our roadmap is allowing this tool to be usable by any DAO in the world and also creating other tools focused on increasing community interaction with DAOS and helping to manage DAOS better. After many conversations with people from different DAOS like makerDAO we concluded that this could be a huge leverage point for the ecosystem
how_its_made:
We run on top of polygon network to pull data onChain from it, we use aleph to achieve this purpose and store data onChain, we use snapshot protocol to view, make and show proposals. Also we are running on fleek, so underneath the hood means that we are using IPFS.

Protocols from Zola running on top of Polygon can use our technology to get more information  about their organization.
